findings.condition: Three employees (E1125, E1140, E1145) completed new-hire security training 49, 52, and 56 days respectively after their hire dates, exceeding the 30-day limit specified in the policy.
findings.criteria: Section 2.1: New employees complete 'Security Awareness - New Hire' within 30 calendar days of their hire date.
findings.cause: Training completions were delayed beyond the required timeframe without documented approval or exception.
findings.effect: Employees were not protected by security awareness training during the initial period of employment, creating exposure to security risks.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated reminders for managers and new hires to ensure training is completed within 30 days. Establish an exception process requiring documented approval for any delays, and enforce timely completion through follow-up procedures.

findings.condition: VULN-0037 (CVE-2026-16362) was open for 50 calendar days before closure, exceeding the 30-day remediation SLA. The vulnerability has no associated risk acceptance ticket.
findings.criteria: Policy section 2.2: 'Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 30 calendar days of being opened.'
findings.cause: No approved risk acceptance was obtained for this critical vulnerability despite the extended remediation timeline.
findings.effect: A critical vulnerability remained unremediated beyond the required 30-day window without documented exception approval, creating exposure to potential exploitation.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all critical vulnerabilities are either remediated within 30 days or have an approved risk acceptance ticket (signed by Security Lead and CTO) before the 30-day deadline expires. Implement monitoring alerts for vulnerabilities approaching the 30-day threshold.
